question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"down."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Running down"** is a phrase used to describe the action of a liquid or an object in a liquid state moving downward.
 
• In the context of the sentence **"It is like icicles running down your spine or aluminum in your mouth,"** the phrase **"running down your spine"** suggests the sensation of something cold or chilling, akin to the feeling of icicles slowly melting and trickling down your back.
 
• The correct answer is option 2.
 
• Correct passage:

My breath is halted, like gasping for air after__ crying far too long and hard. It is like a hiccup, with a shivering sharpness __of__ nerves. It is like icicles running __**down**__ your spine or aluminum in your mouth, an eerie amount of emotions that cannot compare ______ (4) ______ the actual feelings you’ve managed to live ______ (5) ______. I just watched you die; I say to myself silently.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Besides" **means in addition to or apart from. (के अतिरिक्त, के साथ; भी)
 
• **"Among"** means surrounded by or in the middle of. (से घिरा हुआ; के बीच में)
 
• **"Thorough"** means complete or exhaustive. (सावधानी से और पूरी तरह किया गया; परिपूर्ण)
